content:
Mira: Quick sync — we're bringing up a small FRA1 cluster for private customers. Need to lock GPUs for initial bootstrap (8x A100-equivalent) + a burst buffer of 16 cards for e2e tests. Can someone confirm the quota procedure? I want to avoid manual back-and-forth with CSP sales during the sprint.

Tyler: I can run intake. Which cloud/provider are we targeting? GCP or AWS?

Mira: GCP europe-west6 (fra1 tag in our infra). Prefer committed seats vs temporary holds. Budget impact ~€8k/mo for a reserved pool. Thinking a 3-month commit to start.

Alex: For quota requests we need an explicit QREQ body with SKU, region, project IDs, justification, and target date. Example payload we should file: 
```
project: infra-fra1
resource: nvidia-a100-80gb
quantity: 8
start_date: 2024-10-15
commit_term: 3_months
business_justification: onboarding private tenants, latency-sensitive inference
contact: alex@redwood.com
```
Also: attach cost approval and PO if commit > $5k/mo.

Jen (SRE): Network note — fra1 has cross-region peering limits. Please include an egress increase request to our peering account (10Gb) in the ticket or bootstrap will be throttled. Also add firewall rules for cluster bootstrap CIDR 10.50.0.0/22.

cap-bot: Capacity check: there is currently 0 available reserved A100 capacity in europe-west6. Forecast suggests 2–3 week lead unless we accept alternate shapes (A10G) or allow multi-region fallback.

Tyler: Plan proposal: Alex files QREQ today using your snippet. I'll add fallback SKU (A10G) and a multi-region fallback (eu-west3). Mira please confirm PO/budget. If cap-bot still shows zero in 48h we switch to fallback.

Mira: Budget confirmed. Prefer reserved seats but will accept burst on dedicated shared pool for test window.

Alex: Filing QREQ now. Tagging @finance for PO approval. Proposed bootstrap sequence: 
- bootstrap control plane (2 small nodes)
- reserve 2 GPUs to validate runtime + perf tests
- ramp to 8 GPUs after network validation
- canary traffic 20% for first 48h with latency/cost monitoring

Jen (SRE): Add this networking validation checklist to the ticket:
- IPAM entries created and propagated
- BGP sessions established and stable
- MTU verified at 9000 end-to-end
- internal DNS propagation checked (internal names for endpoint and model registry)
- firewall and peering ACLs applied

Tyler: I'll schedule a dry-run call with CSP SLA contact this afternoon to walk the QREQ and confirm timelines.

Mira: Assignments: Alex -> file QREQ and attach cost/PO; Tyler -> CSP contact and dry-run; Jen -> create network rules + validation; Mira -> sign-off on budget/PO. If cap-bot shows no reserve in 48h, fallback to multi-region or burst from dedicated pool. Pin this thread.

Alex: Done — QREQ ticket #Q-5421 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/Q-5421. Attached provider SKUs and a cost estimate sheet (link in ticket).

Tyler: Noted. I'll loop in the CSP rep at 16:00 and post notes here. Mira, I'll DM PO details.

cap-bot: Update: Q-5421 accepted for provider review. Expected lead time: 12–14 business days for A100; 2–3 days for A10G.

Mira: Great — reconvene in 48h unless approvals come sooner. :thumbsup:
